ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination at 2-6 mo ripening, low volatile ammonia vs long-aged grana.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol ~5-7 ug/kg from tyrosine degradation and pasture phenols, not stable-like.

bitter.reason: Some hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis, partly masked by 1.6% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium spp.; low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone only from fatty acid beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Proteolysis-derived free amino groups plus residual galactose drive Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Moderate diacetyl 34-49 ug/kg plus acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism in fatty matrix.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High butyric ~44k ug/kg plus hexanoic ~29k ug/kg from lipase lipolysis gives sweaty-cheesy.

creaminess.reason: 35.3% fat gives lubrication but low 30.7% moisture and firm Ca-paracasein limits creamy flow.

crumbliness.reason: Intermediate proteolysis and moisture loss create short fracture but not dry grana crumble.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 30.7% with semi-cooked pressed curd and dense Ca-paracasein network gives firm body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace benzaldehyde/phenyl derivatives and fruity esters; low phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: High ethyl butanoate ~547 ug/kg plus ethyl hexanoate from NSLAB esterification of acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Moderate C6/C8 acids present but no goat-milk branched 4-methyl/4-ethyl octanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Leu/Ile Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal drive malty-nutty aged alpine note.

melt.reason: pH 5.32 with partly demineralized paracasein allows good softening and flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no bloomy rind, minimal fungal pathways.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-fat coalescence on heating from 35.3% fat cooked curd with limited oiling.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked natural rind; no guaiacol or smoke phenols detected.

sour_vinegar.reason: Abundant acetic acid ~70k ug/kg plus lactic acid at pH 5.32 from starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water kneading, so minimal oriented stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Trace methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide from methionine catabolism; semi-cooked curd adds slight cooked note.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but glycerol, D-amino acids and fruity esters give slight sweet perception.

umami.reason: Moderate proteolysis releases glutamate/aspartate plus savory peptides during ripening.
